title: Wire broadened search and filter state into RecipesListView
description: Update the recipes list to use the expanded free-text predicate, combine it with active filters, persist filter state per scene, present the filter sheet from the toolbar, and show the filtered empty state with a clear-filters affordance.
acceptance_criteria: Free-text matching checks `displayName`, `metadata.title`, normalized tags, and ingredient names with case-insensitive substring semantics.
`RecipesListView` stores filter state in `@SceneStorage`, shows the filter toolbar button with filled/unfilled symbol variants, and displays the active-filter badge count when nonzero.
The empty state distinguishes filter-driven zero results from query-only zero results and preserves the query when clearing filters.

handoff_summary.completed: All three acceptance criteria implemented: broadened free-text search, @SceneStorage filter state with toolbar badge, and distinct filter-driven empty state with clear-filters affordance that preserves query.
handoff_summary.risks: SourceKit reports false-positive "Cannot find X in scope" errors for CookbookCore types — these are worktree resolver artifacts, not compiler errors; all referenced types existed and compiled before this bead. RecipesTab adds a .navigationBarTrailing gear toolbar item at the parent level; the filter button added from RecipesListView will appear to the gear's left in the trailing group, which is standard iOS toolbar behaviour but should be visually verified.
handoff_summary.next_action: Hand off to tester agent to verify acceptance criteria against the live UI.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: RecipesFilterSheet.swift was not modified; no conflict risk there. RecipesActiveFilters.swift gained Codable — a purely additive protocol conformance, no conflict risk. RecipesListView.swift was fully rewritten; any downstream bead that also touches this file should rebase.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Filter state serialised as JSON Data via Codable rather than a custom string encoding, because RecipesActiveFilters contains Set<String> and optional primitives that map cleanly to JSON with zero custom logic. The clear-filters empty state is implemented inline in RecipesListView rather than extending EmptyStateView, to avoid expanding scope of a shared component for a single caller. Badge overlaid via ZStack+offset rather than SwiftUI .badge() (tab-bar only) or a custom ViewModifier, keeping it self-contained in the toolbar button builder.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: filteredSections predicate logic (all four search axes, filter+query AND composition, empty-section pruning) and the Codable round-trip on RecipesActiveFilters are the primary candidates for unit tests. UI-only behaviours (badge rendering, sheet presentation, @SceneStorage restoration across scene transitions) require manual or UI-test verification.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: The filter button badge uses a fixed red background; it does not adapt to custom tint colours. The badge is positioned via offset(x:8, y:-8) which is tuned for the standard SF Symbol size — dynamic type changes to the toolbar font could shift it slightly.

conflict_risks: RecipesFilterSheet.swift was not modified; no conflict risk there. RecipesActiveFilters.swift gained Codable — a purely additive protocol conformance, no conflict risk. RecipesListView.swift was fully rewritten; any downstream bead that also touches this file should rebase.

execution_history.summary: Wired broadened search and filter state into RecipesListView. Added Codable to RecipesActiveFilters for @SceneStorage persistence. Rewrote RecipesListView with: (1) broadened free-text predicate covering displayName, metadata.title, normalizedTags, and ingredient names; (2) combined filter+query application in filteredSections; (3) @SceneStorage-backed JSON filter state; (4) toolbar filter button with filled/unfilled icon variant and badge count overlay; (5) filter sheet presentation; (6) empty-state branching that distinguishes filter-driven zero results (shows filterEmptyState with "Clear Filters" button that preserves query) from query-only zero results (EmptyStateView).

- Redesign unrelated architecture or broaden scope beyond the assigned bead.
- Perform final review signoff in place of a review agent.
- Silently absorb unrelated test, documentation, or planning work that should be handed off.

Expected outputs:
- Completed or blocked JSON with concise implementation summary.
- Accurate touched files, changed files, risks, and follow-up handoff fields.
